_comment: Static fallback for Open-Meteo hourly cloud cover. Shape mirrors the real api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast contract so OpenMeteoClient.parse(JsonNode) can parse it unchanged. At load time (Step 5, MockData), the 'time' array is RE-ANCHORED to today's 00:00 UTC (per Clock) keeping the same hour-of-day cloud_cover curve, so offline demos always resolve a cloud value for the mock pass window. Values below show a clear-sky (<20%) morning so Alert 2 ('Clear skies predicted') can trigger against the mock passes.
